title: Objective Rewriter Workbench
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Learning Objectives
Measurable Objectives
Bloom Verbs
Instructional Design
description: A p5.js workbench that splits eight weak learning objectives into actor, action, concept, and condition-and-standard slots; learners choose observable Bloom verbs, name a learning-graph concept, add a condition and a standard, and compare their repair with a stored model repair.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers and learning-technology developers

learningObjectives: Use the actor, action, concept and condition-and-standard checklist to repair a weak learning objective.
Replace an unobservable verb with an observable Bloom verb.

controls.label: Action verb
controls.options: 24 verbs labeled with Bloom level, 4 of them unobservable

controls.label: Concept
controls.behavior: green when it matches a learning-graph concept label, amber otherwise; datalist suggestions

assumptions: A concept matches when the field equals a learning-graph label or contains a multi-word label.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Worked example followed by guided practice with model answers
keyQuestions: What observation would separate a learner who meets this objective from one who does not?
Does the verb you chose change the Bloom level the objective aims at?
commonMisconceptions: Understand, know and appreciate are acceptable objective verbs.
A topic such as 'xAPI' is the same as a concept a learner can be assessed on.
An objective without a standard can still be judged met or not met.
assessmentOpportunities: Score out of five parts for each repaired objective.
A quiz question written to match one repaired objective.
